articles.title: Russian Jets Zoom Dangerously Close to UK Spy Plane Over the Black Sea!
articles.summary: Two Russian fighter jets flew super close to a British spy plane over the Black Sea. One got just six metres away! The UK says this was really dangerous and could have caused a crash.

articles.title: Man Jailed for Facebook Meme About Charlie Kirk Wins $835,000!
articles.summary: Larry Bushart, a retired police officer, was arrested for posting a meme about Charlie Kirk on Facebook. He spent 37 days in jail before the charge was dropped. Now he's getting $835,000 because his free speech rights were violated.

articles.title: Good News for Drivers: Fuel Tax Cut Extended Until End of Year!
articles.summary: The UK government is keeping the 5p cut on fuel duty until the end of 2026. That means petrol and diesel won't get more expensive for now. The war in Iran has pushed up fuel prices, so this helps drivers and farmers.
